about.title: Rituals kept whole, wherever you are
about.lead: poozari.com exists for the devotee who wants a puja performed properly and cannot always be there in person. We connect you to verified pandits at the temples and teerths where a ritual is meant to be done, and we send the whole thing back to you on video, with prasad.
about.story: Families move — to another city, another country — but the occasions that call for a puja do not move with them. A shraddh falls due. A new house needs a Griha Pravesh. A Nag Bali has been pending for years. The old way was to phone a relative, hope they knew a pandit, and never really know what was performed. We built poozari.com so that the chain from your sankalp to the completed ritual is visible end to end.

values.title: The ritual, done properly
values.body: Every puja is performed to its prescribed vidhi with complete samagri. No shortcuts, no combined sankalps, no substitutions you were not told about.

values.title: Pandits you can check
values.body: Each pujari is verified before joining — lineage, training and years of practice. Their name and details are on your booking, not hidden behind a brand.

values.title: Your sankalp, named
values.body: The puja is performed in your name and gotra. You hear it in the recording.

values.title: Proof, not promises
values.body: You receive a recorded video of your pooja and, where offered, prasad couriered to your address.

about.ctaBody: Browse the rituals we perform, or tell us what you need and we will guide you.

howItWorks.title: Four steps, and we take it from there
howItWorks.lead: From choosing a ritual to receiving the video, here is exactly what happens and what we need from you.

steps.title: Choose the puja and package
steps.body: Pick the ritual, and where it should be performed — at your home, at a temple, or at the teerth prescribed for it. Each package lists precisely what is included, from samagri to the number of pandits.

steps.title: Give your sankalp details
steps.body: Your name, gotra and the date you would like. This is what the pandit recites when the puja is offered in your name. Save it to your profile once and it pre-fills next time.

steps.title: Pay securely
steps.body: Payment is taken in Indian Rupees through Razorpay — UPI, cards, netbanking or wallets. You get a booking reference immediately.

steps.title: A verified pandit is assigned
steps.body: We match your booking to a verified pujari by service area and specialisation, usually within hours. You see who they are and can follow the status as it moves.

steps.title: The puja is performed and recorded
steps.body: The ritual is carried out on the agreed date and filmed. Your recording appears in your account, and prasad is couriered where the package includes it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: What we collect when you book a puja, why we need it, and what we do with it.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: To perform a puja in your name we need your name, gotra, mobile number and, where the ritual is at your home or prasad is being couriered, your address. Where you provide them, we also hold your email address, date of birth and gender. Payments are taken by Razorpay; card and UPI details go to them directly and are never stored on our servers.

sections.heading: Why we need it
sections.body: Your name and gotra are recited during the sankalp — the ritual cannot be performed in your name without them. Your mobile number is how we send the login OTP and booking updates. Your address is used to assign a pandit in your area and to deliver prasad. We do not collect anything we do not need for the booking.

sections.heading: Who else sees it
sections.body: The pandit assigned to your booking sees the sankalp details and, for a home puja, the address and phone number needed to reach you. Razorpay receives what is required to take the payment. Our SMS provider receives your mobile number to deliver the OTP. Courier partners receive the delivery address for prasad and store orders. We do not sell your data, and we do not share it for anyone else's advertising.

sections.heading: Your pooja video
sections.body: The recording of your puja is stored so that you can watch it from your account. It is linked to your booking and is not published publicly by us. If you want it deleted, ask us and we will remove it.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Booking, payment and invoice records are kept as long as Indian tax and accounting rules require. Your account details are kept while your account is open. Login OTPs expire within minutes and are stored only as a hash.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can see and correct your details from your profile at any time. Write to us to request a copy of your data, correct something we hold, or close your account and delete what is not required by law. You can opt out of promotional messages without affecting booking updates.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies for the things the site cannot work without: keeping you logged in, remembering your language and your display currency. We do not use them to track you across other websites.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: Passwords are stored hashed, never in plain text. Access to booking data is limited to the pandit assigned and our own staff who need it. No system is perfect; if a breach ever affects you, we will tell you.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about your data, or a request to delete it, go through our Contact page and are handled by a person, not a form reply.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lead: The agreement between you and poozari.com when you book a ritual through us.

sections.heading: What we do
sections.body: poozari.com arranges for Vedic rituals to be performed by verified pandits, at your home, at a temple, or at a teerth, and delivers a recording of the ritual to you. When you book, you are engaging us to arrange and deliver that ritual.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: Accounts are verified by an OTP sent to your mobile number. Keep access to that number secure — anything done from your account is treated as done by you. Give accurate sankalp details: a puja performed with the wrong name or gotra cannot be undone.

sections.heading: Bookings and confirmation
sections.body: A booking is confirmed once payment succeeds and you receive a reference. Your preferred date is a request, not a guarantee: some rituals must fall on a prescribed tithi or muhurat, and temple and teerth availability varies. We will tell you the confirmed date, and if we cannot meet a date you need, you may cancel for a full refund.

sections.heading: Pandit assignment
sections.body: We assign a verified pandit by service area and specialisation. If your assigned pandit becomes unavailable we will reassign to another verified pandit of comparable standing rather than delay your ritual, and we will tell you.

sections.heading: Prices and payment
sections.body: All prices are in Indian Rupees and every payment is charged in Indian Rupees. Prices shown in other currencies are indicative conversions for your convenience; the amount that reaches your card or bank statement is the rupee amount, converted by your own bank at its rate. Package prices include what the package lists and nothing more.

sections.heading: What we deliver
sections.body: We deliver the ritual described in the package you chose, performed to its prescribed vidhi, together with a recording. Where the package includes prasad, we courier it to the address you gave. A ritual is a religious observance: we do not promise any particular worldly outcome from it, and no such promise should be inferred from anything on this site.

sections.heading: Live Darshan
sections.body: Where a session has a join fee, that fee buys access to that streamed session. Streams depend on connectivity at the temple or teerth; if a session you paid to join does not take place, we refund the join fee.

sections.heading: Store orders
sections.body: Puja essentials bought from our store are governed by these terms together with our Shipping Policy and Cancellation & Refund Policy.

sections.heading: Conduct
sections.body: Do not use the site to abuse or harass pandits or staff, to misrepresent who you are, or to interfere with the service. We may suspend an account for this.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: The text, photographs and video on this site belong to us or our contributors. Your own pooja recording is yours to keep and share; everything else is not to be republished without permission.

sections.heading: Limits of our liability
sections.body: We are responsible for arranging and delivering the ritual you booked. Where we fail to do so, our responsibility is limited to re-performing the ritual or refunding what you paid for it, as set out in our Cancellation & Refund Policy. We are not responsible for delays caused by events outside our control, such as temple closures, restrictions on gatherings, natural events, or a courier's failure.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may change these terms; the version published here at the time of your booking is the one that governs it.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of India, and the courts of India have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.

refund.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
refund.lead: When you can cancel, what comes back to you, and how long it takes.

sections.heading: Cancelling a puja booking
sections.body: You may cancel a booking free of charge until a pandit has been assigned and samagri has been arranged. Once the pandit is assigned and preparation has begun, part of the cost has already been committed on your behalf — see the timelines below.

sections.heading: Refund timelines
sections.body: More than 72 hours before the scheduled date: full refund. Between 24 and 72 hours: 75% refunded, the balance covering samagri already purchased and the pandit's committed time. Under 24 hours: 50% refunded. After the ritual has been performed: no refund, because the puja cannot be un-performed.

sections.heading: When we cancel
sections.body: If we cannot perform your ritual — no pandit available, a temple or teerth closure, or any failure on our side — you get a full refund, including any delivery charge, or you may move the booking to another date at no cost. The choice is yours, not ours.

sections.heading: If something was wrong with the puja
sections.body: If the ritual was not performed as the package described, tell us within 7 days of receiving your recording. We will look at the recording and the pandit's report, and either arrange for the ritual to be performed again at our cost or refund you. We would rather re-perform it properly than simply refund you.

sections.heading: Missing or unusable video
sections.body: The recording is part of what you paid for. If it never arrives or is unusable, and the ritual itself was performed correctly, we refund the part of the price attributable to the recording, or re-perform the ritual if you prefer.

sections.heading: Live Darshan join fees
sections.body: A join fee is refunded in full if the session does not take place or the stream fails for reasons on our side. Once you have watched a session, the fee is not refundable.

sections.heading: Store orders
sections.body: Unopened puja essentials may be returned within 7 days of delivery for a full refund of the item price. Consumables that have been opened cannot be returned for hygiene and ritual-purity reasons. Damaged or wrong items are replaced or refunded in full — send us a photograph within 48 hours of delivery.

sections.heading: How refunds reach you
sections.body: Refunds go back through Razorpay to the same method you paid with. We initiate them within 3 working days of approving the request; your bank typically takes a further 5 to 7 working days. Payments made in rupees are refunded in rupees — if your bank converted the charge, the amount that lands may differ slightly from what left, because the exchange rate has moved. That difference is your bank's, not ours.

sections.heading: How to ask
sections.body: Use our Contact page with your booking reference (POZ-…). A person reads it. We do not require you to explain yourself at length.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.lead: How prasad and store orders reach you — and how your pooja video is delivered.

sections.heading: What gets shipped
sections.body: Two things travel physically: prasad from a puja whose package includes it, and puja essentials bought from our store. The pooja recording is not shipped — it appears in your account.

sections.heading: Your pooja video
sections.body: The recording is uploaded by the pandit after the ritual and normally appears in your account within 48 hours of the puja. You will be notified. Nothing needs to be delivered for you to watch it.

sections.heading: Prasad dispatch
sections.body: Prasad is dispatched within 3 working days of the ritual being completed, by courier, to the address on your booking. Please keep that address current — prasad is dispatched to what we hold at the time of the puja.

sections.heading: Store dispatch
sections.body: Store orders are dispatched within 2 working days of payment, subject to stock. If something is out of stock we will tell you and offer a substitute or a refund rather than hold your order silently.

sections.heading: Delivery times within India
sections.body: Metro cities: typically 2 to 4 working days after dispatch. Other cities and towns: 4 to 7 working days. Remote pincodes: up to 10 working days. These are courier estimates, not guarantees.

sections.heading: Delivery charges
sections.body: Any delivery charge is shown at checkout before you pay. Where a puja package states that prasad is included, its delivery is included too.

sections.heading: International delivery
sections.body: We serve devotees outside India, and the pooja video reaches you wherever you are. Physical prasad and store items ship within India only. If you are booking from abroad, give an Indian delivery address for anything physical — or choose a package without prasad.

sections.heading: Tracking
sections.body: You receive a tracking reference by SMS or email once your parcel is dispatched, and order status is visible in your account.

sections.heading: If a parcel is lost or damaged
sections.body: Tell us within 48 hours of the delivery date. Damaged or lost prasad and store items are replaced at our cost where we can, or refunded. Send a photograph of any damage — it settles the matter with the courier faster.

sections.heading: Undelivered parcels
sections.body: If a courier cannot reach you after reasonable attempts, the parcel comes back to us and we will contact you to arrange redelivery. A second delivery charge may apply where the address given was wrong.

faq.subtitle: Common questions about coordinating Vedic and temple pujas online.

items.q: Do I need to arrange the samagri myself?
items.a: No. For any puja you book through poozari, we coordinate the complete premium puja samagri along with the verified pandit. You only share your sankalp details — we handle the rest.
Choose a puja, select a package, add your sankalp details and complete secure payment. The assigned pandit performs the ritual and shares completion proof, including a recorded video.

items.q: Can I book a puja for a specific date and muhurat?
items.a: Yes. During checkout you can share your preferred date and time. Our team confirms pandit availability and the final schedule.
Yes. Every pandit is screened for ritual knowledge and service quality before being assigned to bookings.

items.q: What is included in puja packages?
items.a: Package inclusions vary by ritual and can include samagri, sankalp process, vidhi details, and video proof. Each package card lists exact inclusions.

items.q: Can devotees outside India book puja services?
items.a: Yes. Devotees in India and abroad can book rituals, share sankalp details digitally, and watch the recorded pooja video online.
